messages.text: Hola team t03, come list and trade on El Club · Where Madrid Trades (venue v03): just a 1% fee with no per-card charge, versus 5% + 1 P per card at El Rastro. Matching is at a fair midpoint, with the best pairs filled first, so we'd love to see your cards there!
Hola! On El Rastro we sell: LAV-08 at 22 P, MAL-06 at 22 P, LAV-01 at 6 P, LAV-03 at 6 P, LAV-05 at 6 P, MAL-02 at 6 P. Send a structured offer (give cash, want card:<id>) and we talk.
